europe_now.title: Russian Strikes on Zaporizhzhia
europe_now.summary: Recent Russian military strikes targeting Ukraine's Zaporizhzhia region resulted in at least seven fatalities, including children. The incident adds to ongoing security concerns and structural destruction within the conflict zone.

europe_now.title: Sanctions Investigation in the Czech Republic
europe_now.summary: Investigators have traced potential sanctions-evasion links connecting Czech Vanadium ownership to Russian oligarch Roman Abramovich. The inquiry highlights ongoing enforcement challenges regarding asset ownership across European jurisdictions.
